description: Use when a user asks about llms.txt. Fetches /llms.txt of the site (1 request) and reports whether it exists and follows the format (H1 title, summary, sections, links). Also states the evidence honestly: llms.txt is unproven for AI visibility. Returns a minimal template when the file is missing.

url.description: Any URL on the site, or a bare domain; /llms.txt is looked up at its origin

name: check_llms_txt
title: Check a site's llms.txt
